description: React component for managing and displaying a list of channels with pagination, filtering, and auto-add toggle features in the Mattermost admin console.

classes.name: ChannelList
classes.description: React component for listing channels with filtering, pagination, and auto-add controls.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes state and sets up debounced search function.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads initial page of channels when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cancels debounced search and marks component as unmounted.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to search term and filters, triggers search or resets pagination.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Fetches a page of channels based on current filters and pagination state.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of channels.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of channels including channels to add.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Returns pagination display info: start, end, total counts.

methods.name: removeChannel
methods.description: Marks a channel for removal and adjusts pagination if needed.

methods.name: handleAutoAddToggle
methods.description: Toggles auto-add status for a specific channel.

methods.name: getChannelAutoAddStatus
methods.description: Gets current auto-add status for a channel, considering pending changes.

methods.name: getAllChannelsAutoAddStatus
methods.description: Determines if all visible channels are uniformly auto-added or not.

methods.name: handleBulkAutoAddToggle
methods.description: Toggles auto-add status for all visible channels.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid, including auto-add toggle and remove actions.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates row data for the data grid, including channel info and controls.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Handles filter changes for team filtering.
